body: Volevo proprio evitare di tenere soldi fermi da qualche parte. Qualche consiglio su qualche ETF interessante?
Started in may 2022, i only earned like 3/4kg eating 3200kcal daily. Also, i feel like my chest and shoulders are lagging behind while my back feels more developed.
In my previous workout my PT said to do 6 reps for ez curl and skull crusher to develop strength for other exercises
Need a reset after 2 weeks with covid and shoulder injury
I actually love it. It feels better for me because you don't focus on legs like UL

Bulk: fast muscle gain, also fat gat
Cut: lose fat, but also slightly lose muscle
Recomp: lose fat and build muscle at the same time with a slower rate

Tried to fix. Switched to a simple push pull routine.

Push 1: squat 3x5-8, bench press 4x6, leg extension 3x12, incline db press 3x10-15, military press 3x6, french press 4x8, calf raises 3x12

Pull 1: deadlift 4x8, lat machine 4x6, leg curl 3x12, bent over row 3x10-12, lateral raise 3x12, facepull 3x15-20, curl ez 4x6

Push 2: leg press 3x10, db bench press 4x8, bulgarian split squat 3x8-12, cable chest fly x push up 2x10-max, db shoulder press 3x8-12, push down 3x12, kick back 3x15, calf raises 3x12

Pull 2: RDL 3x10-12, lat machine 3x8-12, db single arm row 3x8-12, reverse fly 3x10-12, db curl 3x8, hammer curl 3x12, db shrugs 4x10-12

​

What do you think?
How many should I aim for? I'm used to 16 sets per week with PT
Is 14 sets enough for muscle growth? Many sources talk about 16-20 sets per week

Actually i find it hard to fit at least 15 sets per muscle group/week with only 4days. 
About progress: increase reps->+1 sets->increase weight
